scorer.authority: The scorer consumes one strict raw W7 observation, decodes the candidate and cold F32 logits/state probes, and derives every check. Caller-supplied pass booleans are absent from the schema.

primary_regime.wire_fixture: The exact prompt/prime/append builder must be committed before the unchanged-code runtime RED. Its wire bytes, canonical request tokens, actual sync tokens, restored checkpoint tokens, and final evaluated lineage receive separate hashes.
checkpoint_inventory: The harness independently records every private-KV candidate before launch, including token length, lineage hash, payload hash, structural validity, and modification identity.
The fixture includes one valid shorter matching decoy, one newer wrong-lineage decoy, and one malformed newer record.
The scorer accepts the candidate arm only when the selected payload hash equals the independently expected 5044 payload and positive payload bytes were read.

candidate_requirements: mode is resume and flag value is exactly 1
selected payload equals the expected 5044 payload
the only evaluated prompt range is [5044,5066)
actual sync and final-lineage hashes equal the canonical complete-token hash
cold_fallback_rejection.mutation: Replacing the candidate with a full cold evaluation, even while preserving claimed hashes or matching logits, produces FAIL.

guard_contract.legacy_bypass: DS4_GLM_RESUME_GUARD_OFF must be absent in the complete environment for every arm.
guard_contract.candidate_flag: Only the exact value 1 enables the experiment. Unset, 0, empty, and malformed values preserve strict behavior.
guard_contract.flag_on_controls: Divergence, shortening, malformed checkpoint, wrong lineage, and non-GLM cases run with the candidate flag both disabled and enabled. None may select or read a resume payload.
guard_contract.exact_replay: Flag-off and flag-on exact replay must use replay mode without reset, invalidation, or new prompt evaluation.

numeric_fields: a fixed 256-value finite F32 state probe drawn from preregistered tensor ranges

artifact_writer_requirements: Artifacts are request-ID, arm, sync-invocation, prompt-hash, and final-position qualified.
Each artifact has a self-describing header, exact dimensions, byte count, tensor inventory, and content hash.
GPU reads are synchronized and any omitted or failed read/write makes the arm fail.
The production-path RED uses actual matcher/loader/session-sync primitives; test hooks may observe or inject beneath those primitives but may not replace their decision logic.
next_sequence: Review this scorer/schema candidate; engine implementation remains unauthorized until critical/high findings are gone.
